posts.hook: For several hours on Friday night, no plane in America was allowed to take off
posts.caption: the faa halted every us departure for several hours, its third nationwide ground stop ever, and sources point to a network update, not an attack. reuters reports jensen huang misled nvidia's own general counsel, and a leaked document shows amazon planning to catalog nearly every product sold online. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: The FAA orders its ==third-ever== nationwide ground stop
slides.desc: Sources trace it to a network update that crashed air traffic control links. The FBI sees no attack.

terms.gloss: the us agency that runs air traffic control

slides.title: Amazon plans to catalog nearly every product sold online, even ones it does not sell
slides.desc: A leaked plan aims to make its index the one AI shopping agents rely on.

slides.title: Reuters: Jensen Huang misled Nvidia's own general counsel
slides.desc: The report says several leaders were misled about his relationship with Alice Huang.

slides.title: Sam Bankman-Fried's Anthropic stake would be worth ==about $37B==
slides.desc: The FT's math if Anthropic lists near $1.5 trillion. It was given up in 2024 for about $1.3B.

slides.title: Tesla opens Cybercab orders: about $30K plus a required $299 a month
slides.desc: The subscription is what lets the driverless car operate at all.

slides.title: Starship reaches orbit, setting up a possible upper stage catch on Saturday
slides.desc: Only its second flight to low Earth orbit. Recovering the upper stage is the missing half of reuse.

posts.hook: Italy says Facebook went through Android users' photos without asking. The bill: €805 million
posts.caption: italy's privacy regulator fined meta €805m for allegedly accessing android users' photos and videos without consent. the washington post reports marco rubio's rewrite of a cia report helped bring down jensen huang, and microsoft says its 365 outage is fully over. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: Italy fines Meta ==€805M== over Android users' photos and videos
slides.desc: The regulator alleges Meta accessed them without consent and without informing users.

slides.title: Washington Post: Rubio's rewrite of a CIA report helped topple Jensen Huang
slides.desc: A source says he recast the CIA's reporting on Alice Huang in more assertive terms.

slides.title: Claude can now sit in your Google Meet call as a visible participant
slides.desc: In beta on Team and Enterprise plans: it answers in chat, takes notes and saves no audio.

slides.title: When an agent's safety hook crashes, two frameworks run the tool anyway
slides.desc: A researcher found it in CrewAI and the Claude Agent SDK. A broken check protects nothing.

terms.gloss: an open-source toolkit for building teams of ai agents

slides.title: Trump Media has until November 30 to repay up to ==$1B== in bonds
slides.desc: It sold them last May to buy bitcoin. Its shares are down more than 60% this year.

slides.title: Webb finds water ice around a young star, mixed like the ice in our own comets
slides.desc: It suggests the ingredients for water-rich planets are common around young stars.
